mapper.select: select * from member order by case member_no when 'M110001' then 1 when 'M100001' then 2 when 'M010001' then 3 else 4 end, case level when 'SVIP' then 1 when 'VIP' then 2 else 3 end, id asc
select * from member where phone = #{phone} or phone = replace(#{phone}, '|', '') or phone = concat(substring_index(#{phone}, '|', 1), substring_index(#{phone}, '|', -1)) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into member(member_no, name, phone, level, register_time, remark) values(#{memberNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{level}, #{registerTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update:
update member
member_no = #{memberNo},
name = #{name},
phone = #{phone},
level = #{level},
register_time = #{registerTime},
remark = #{remark},
where id = #{id}
